name: mass
header: def mass {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ) (E : α → Prop) : ℝ

name: change
header: def change {α : Type*} (E F : α → Prop) (t : α) : Prop

name: disagreement
header: def disagreement {α : Type*} (E F : α → Prop) (t : α) : Prop

name: mass_nonneg
header:
theorem mass_nonneg {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ s, 0 ≤ w t) (E : α → Prop) : 0 ≤ mass s w E

name: mass_change_identity
header:
theorem mass_change_identity {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ)
    (E F : α → Prop) :
    mass s w E + mass s w (change E F) =
      mass s w F + mass s w (change F E)

name: mass_compl_sub
header:
theorem mass_compl_sub {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ)
    (E F : α → Prop) :
    mass s w (fun t => ¬ E t) - mass s w (fun t => ¬ F t) =
      mass s w (change E F) - mass s w (change F E)

name: mass_disagreement
header:
theorem mass_disagreement {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ)
    (E F : α → Prop) :
    mass s w (disagreement E F) =
      mass s w (change E F) + mass s w (change F E)

name: abs_mass_compl_sub_le
header:
theorem abs_mass_compl_sub_le {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ s, 0 ≤ w t) (E F : α → Prop) :
    |mass s w (fun t => ¬ E t) - mass s w (fun t => ¬ F t)| ≤
      mass s w (disagreement E F)

name: mass_eq_zero_of_false
header:
theorem mass_eq_zero_of_false {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ)
    (E : α → Prop) (hE : ∀ t ∈ s, ¬ E t) : mass s w E = 0

name: pairedWeight_mask_change
header:
theorem pairedWeight_mask_change (n : ℕ) (N A H D C : ℝ)
    (E F : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    chenPairedElevenWeight n N A H D C E -
      chenPairedElevenWeight n N A H D C F =
      ((chenY6Selected n A H D (change E F) : ℝ) -
        (chenY11Selected n A H D (change E F) : ℝ)) -
      ((chenY6Selected n A H D (change F E) : ℝ) -
        (chenY11Selected n A H D (change F E) : ℝ))

name: pairedWeight_antitone_mask
header:
theorem pairedWeight_antitone_mask {n : ℕ} (hn : Squarefree n)
    (N A H D C : ℝ) (E F : ℕ × ℕ → Prop)
    (hEF : ∀ t, E t → F t) :
    chenPairedElevenWeight n N A H D C F ≤
      chenPairedElevenWeight n N A H D C E

name: sixthSupport
header: abbrev sixthSupport (N : ℕ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)

name: eleventhSupport
header: abbrev eleventhSupport (N : ℕ) : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ))

name: sixthWeight
header: abbrev sixthWeight (N : ℕ) (t : ℕ × ℕ) : ℝ

name: eleventhWeight
header: abbrev eleventhWeight (N : ℕ) (t : (ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)) : ℝ

name: sixthMass
header: def sixthMass (N : ℕ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) : ℝ

name: eleventhMass
header: def eleventhMass (N : ℕ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) : ℝ

name: retainedSupport
header: def retainedSupport (N : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)

name: retainedMass
header: def retainedMass (N : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) : ℝ

name: upsilon6_eq_compl_mass
header:
theorem upsilon6_eq_compl_mass (N : ℕ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    currentChenUpsilon6 N E = sixthMass N (fun t => ¬ E t)

name: upsilon11_eq_compl_mass
header:
theorem upsilon11_eq_compl_mass (N : ℕ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    currentChenUpsilon11 N E = eleventhMass N (fun t => ¬ E t)

name: retained_eq_compl_mass
header:
theorem retained_eq_compl_mass (N : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    currentChenUpsilon6Retained N E eta = retainedMass N eta (fun t => ¬ E t)

name: upsilon6_mask_change
header:
theorem upsilon6_mask_change (N : ℕ) (E F : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    currentChenUpsilon6 N E - currentChenUpsilon6 N F =
      sixthMass N (change E F) - sixthMass N (change F E)

name: upsilon11_mask_change
header:
theorem upsilon11_mask_change (N : ℕ) (E F : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    currentChenUpsilon11 N E - currentChenUpsilon11 N F =
      eleventhMass N (change E F) - eleventhMass N (change F E)

name: retained_mask_change
header:
theorem retained_mask_change (N : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) (E F : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    currentChenUpsilon6Retained N E eta - currentChenUpsilon6Retained N F eta =
      retainedMass N eta (change E F) - retainedMass N eta (change F E)

name: pairedPrimeSum_mask_change
header:
theorem pairedPrimeSum_mask_change (N : ℕ) (E F : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    currentChenPairedPrimeSum N E - currentChenPairedPrimeSum N F =
      (sixthMass N (change E F) - eleventhMass N (change E F)) -
        (sixthMass N (change F E) - eleventhMass N (change F E))

name: retained_pair_mask_change
header:
theorem retained_pair_mask_change (N : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) (E F : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    (currentChenUpsilon6Retained N E eta - currentChenUpsilon11 N E) -
      (currentChenUpsilon6Retained N F eta - currentChenUpsilon11 N F) =
      (retainedMass N eta (change E F) - eleventhMass N (change E F)) -
        (retainedMass N eta (change F E) - eleventhMass N (change F E))

name: abs_upsilon6_mask_change_le
header:
theorem abs_upsilon6_mask_change_le (N : ℕ) (E F : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    |currentChenUpsilon6 N E - currentChenUpsilon6 N F| ≤
      sixthMass N (disagreement E F)

name: abs_upsilon11_mask_change_le
header:
theorem abs_upsilon11_mask_change_le (N : ℕ) (E F : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    |currentChenUpsilon11 N E - currentChenUpsilon11 N F| ≤
      eleventhMass N (disagreement E F)

name: abs_retained_mask_change_le
header:
theorem abs_retained_mask_change_le (N : ℕ) (eta : ℝ)
    (E F : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    |currentChenUpsilon6Retained N E eta - currentChenUpsilon6Retained N F eta| ≤
      retainedMass N eta (disagreement E F)

name: abs_pairedPrimeSum_mask_change_le
header:
theorem abs_pairedPrimeSum_mask_change_le (N : ℕ) (E F : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    |currentChenPairedPrimeSum N E - currentChenPairedPrimeSum N F| ≤
      sixthMass N (disagreement E F) + eleventhMass N (disagreement E F)

name: abs_retained_pair_mask_change_le
header:
theorem abs_retained_pair_mask_change_le (N : ℕ) (eta : ℝ)
    (E F : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    |(currentChenUpsilon6Retained N E eta - currentChenUpsilon11 N E) -
      (currentChenUpsilon6Retained N F eta - currentChenUpsilon11 N F)| ≤
      retainedMass N eta (disagreement E F) + eleventhMass N (disagreement E F)
